overall_notes: This paper focuses on evaluating automatic verifiers of reasoning chains rather than evaluating the NLG outputs themselves. The human evaluation creates a benchmark dataset (REVEAL) with fine-grained annotations of reasoning chain quality. The automatic metrics (macro-F1) are used to evaluate the verifiers' performance, not the generated text quality directly. LLMs are used as verifiers/judges of reasoning chains rather than as generation models.
